input: Enroll my toddler in a music and movement class

gold.taskTitle: Enroll Toddler in Music and Movement Class
gold.taskDescription: Find and enroll a toddler in a suitable local music and movement class.

questions.title: How old is your toddler right now?
questions.description: The child's exact age in months or years determines age-appropriate class options and eligibility requirements.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the class be in?
questions.description: The location narrows the search to classes that are realistically accessible for regular attendance.

questions.title: Which days of the week work for your schedule?
questions.description: Knowing available days ensures only classes with compatible scheduling are considered.

questions.title: Will a parent or caregiver attend the class too?
questions.description: Many toddler music classes require a participating adult, which affects which programs are suitable.

questions.title: Do you have a budget per month or per session?
questions.description: A budget ceiling filters out options that are not financially feasible before time is spent researching them.

questions.title: Is there a specific program you have already heard of?
questions.description: If the user already has a program in mind such as Kindermusik or Music Together, the plan can focus on enrolling there directly.

questions.title: When do you want the class to start?
questions.description: A target start date determines urgency and whether to look for immediate openings or upcoming session registrations.
